items.title: Tre' Harris: Career-best yardage total in win
items.body_text: Harris secured all five targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mark Andrews: Season-best effort in Brissett's debut
items.body_text: Andrews brought in all eight targets for 82 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Herbert: Efficient in first win of season
items.body_text: Herbert completed 12 of 18 passes for 129 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed seven times for 51 yards and a touchdown in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Solid night marred by key fumble
items.body_text: Flowers brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and lost a fumble in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Impressive in team debut
items.body_text: Brissett completed 33 of 49 passes for 340 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for two yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
